_comment: Baseline of Tuas Power figures as verified 24 Aug 2026 against Tuas's own factsheets and campaign pages. The tripwire compares live values against this file. When a change is confirmed and the site is updated, update this file too — otherwise the tripwire keeps firing on the same change.

factsheet_versions._comment: Tuas encodes date and ex-GST rate in the PDF filename, e.g. powerfix_36_20260828(269.7)-$160_bill_rebate.pdf = 28 Aug 2026, 26.97c ex-GST. Since 28 Aug 2026 the filenames also carry a '-$N_bill_rebate' suffix; check.py's FACTSHEET_RE was widened on 7 Sep 2026 to tolerate it. A filename change is the single most reliable repricing signal.
factsheet_versions._bootstrap: A value of "unknown" means: track this plan, but adopt whatever the first run observes and write it back here. PowerFIX 36/24/12 and 25 G+ were all confirmed by hand against Tuas's own plans page on 7 Sep 2026. powerdot_6 stays unknown because its filename encodes a percentage ("(10_)") rather than a decimal rate and the rate group does not match it.

rates_inc_gst_cents._comment: Tuas Power plans, GST-inclusive. Re-verified 7 Sep 2026 against savewithtuas.com/our-electricity-plans/: rates UNCHANGED from 1 Sep, but the PowerFIX 36 and 24 factsheets were reissued dated 28 Aug 2026 at the same ex-GST rates (269.7 / 273.4).

campaign._comment: ONLINE: $100 on PowerFIX 24, $160 on PowerFIX 36, BILL CREDIT ONLY - no grocery e-voucher - first 500 successful sign-ups, to 11 Oct 2026. RE-VERIFIED 7 Sep 2026 against three independent sources that agree: /promotions/, /promotions/online/, and the factsheet filenames which now embed the rebate ($100 / $160). Replaced ONSGDAY26 (National Day, $120/$200, e-voucher option) which ended 31 Aug 2026. The old warning to ignore /promotions/online/ as a stale July campaign no longer holds. CAVEAT found 7 Sep 2026: /promotions/ states the referral 'bill rebate will be revised when combined with another promotion', so the $160+$20=$180 stack is not guaranteed. Other live campaigns: ONGREEN $100 on PowerFIX 25 G+ (to 11 Oct), PRPL26 StarHub Premier League worth $380 (to 30 Sep), PRUOB UOB cashback (to 11 Oct).

pacificlight_reference_inc_gst_cents._comment: PacificLight repriced on 20 Aug 2026 — Savvy Saver 24: 27.50 -> 29.80, Savvy Saver 36: 27.18 -> 29.40 — read from their own factsheets on 24 Aug 2026. Their factsheet LISTING page IS readable and the slugs encode plan+date, so a real PacificLight tripwire is feasible; see pacificlight_discovery in rates-watch.json. Until that is built, these two numbers are maintained by hand.

pacificlight_factsheet_slugs._comment: PacificLight factsheet slugs as recorded by the nightly Action's pacificlight_discovery block on 2026-08-25T22:56Z, matching the hand-verified position of 24 Aug 2026. Each slug encodes plan AND factsheet date. A NEWER date on any tracked slug, or an UNTRACKED slug appearing, means PacificLight has repriced: read https://pacificlight.com.sg/support/factsheet-detail/<slug> for the rate before and after GST. savvy_saver_24 and savvy_saver_36 carry the site's rate claims and matter most. RE-READ BY HAND 7 Sep 2026 from the factsheet listing: all ten slugs identical to this baseline, so PacificLight has NOT repriced since 20 Aug 2026.

editorial_position._comment: As at 7 Sep 2026 (re-checked; unchanged since 24 Aug 2026) NO retailer is cheapest on rate: all six sit at 29.80c on 24 months, and PacificLight, Tuas and Senoko are all 29.40c on 36. The site no longer argues PacificLight is cheapest — it argues the rebates and perks decide. An INVERSION now means Tuas becoming strictly cheaper than PacificLight, not merely equal to it.
